decision_conditions: There is a lack of a suitable internal communal area for all the occupiers to use simultaneously, and the ceiling heights fail to meet standard requirements of the East London HMO guidance and Local Plan HMO Policy, which would be harmful to the amenity of the occupiers of the HMO. The proposal would therefore fail to provide an adequate living environment for all occupants, contrary to Policy 7 and 8 of the Local Plan 2021 and Policy D6 of the London Plan 2021.

The intensification of the site would generate high levels of activity and result in an unacceptable impact on neighbouring residential occupiers in terms of noise and general disturbance associated with the proposed HMO use contrary to Policies 7 and 8 of the Havering Local Plan 2021.
description: Change of use from an existing HMO (Class C4) to an 8-person HMO (Sui-Generis) including hip-to-gable loft conversion with rear dormer and front roof lights, provision of refuse and cycle storage
